newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB shares bid-only in Tokyo morning trading.
newsitem.headline: LTCB shares bid-only in Tokyo morning trading.

text.p: Shares in the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan (LTCB) were bid-only in Thursday morning trading in Tokyo, cheered by recent news that it and Swiss Bank Corp would form a global strategic alliance, brokers said.
As of 0034 GMT, the shares were bid only at 527 yen after closing on Wednesday at the daily limit high of 507 yen after having been bid-only throughout the day.

On Tuesday, the two banks said they would form a strategic alliance that includes cross-shareholdings of three percent. The banks will set up three joint firms based in Japan to cover investment banking, asset management and private banking.
Traders said the alliance will increase LTCB's capital and help the Japanese bank boost competitiveness in the run up to Tokyo's "Big Bang" financial reforms.
